forward: Load or acquire tagged trees, induce per-class decision lists, derive heads, optionally learn ordered reattachment transformations. Store scans compose ordered selection, raw records, lexical/tag decoding, packing, unpacking, decision lists, transformation replay and reports. Full rescoring, incremental learning and easy-first derivation are alternatives whose equivalence is unverified.

Packing supplies aligned S projections to rules; scan recomputes trees from fixed lists and ordered transformations. Selection order determines the every-twentieth training sample. Shared class and finite identities constrain the interfaces; parent complement is not the union of child complements.
inverse: U is admitted finite calls plus fixed dependency/schedule states paired with returns/effects. Candidate inner U minus R contains successful plain derivation preferring a later finite verb over an earlier one, open-class class() retaining a lexical lemma, and scan_store invoking the annotator. Class exclusion tested; root/call-graph exclusions source-inspected.

For fixed entrypoint, y admits every source tree, list, initial dependency state and schedule x satisfying R(x,y). Equal heads or scores do not uniquely determine lemmas, gold labels, candidate counts or lists. Executed class/unpack collision witnesses demonstrate bounded information loss; full derivation fibers remain prospective.
cost: For sentence lengths n_s, class-list length L and transformations T, conservative derivation/replay bound is O(sum_s (L+T+1)*n_s^2). Fixed-target induction is O(sum_s n_s^2). Search, parser acquisition, I/O and state effects add separate costs. No performance gain claimed.
